OPERATIVE NOTE Tamarack Regional Hospital PATIENT: SZABO-LINDAHL, MARGIT H MRN: N-0231-7746 DOB: 11/03/1998 AGE: 71 SEX: F DATE OF SURGERY: 08/03/2070 LOCATION: OR 4, Suite 2 SURGEON: Anneke de Wit-Pasternak, MD ASSISTANT: Dr. L. Marchetti ANESTHESIA: general PREOPERATIVE DIAGNOSIS: Malignant neoplasm of colon (biopsy 07/13/70); recurrent rectal polyp 7/6. POSTOPERATIVE DIAGNOSIS: Same. PROCEDURE: Laparoscopic sigmoid colectomy w/ primary anastomosis. INDICATIONS: Pt is a seventy one y/o woman, HTN, hyperlipidemia, obestiy (BMI 27.8 on last chart), type 2 DM w/ stage 2 CKD and microalbuminuria sinve February 2069, asthma since 2019. @NAME@ is here for resection. Husband Torbjorn Lindahl present in holding area. Consent signed by pt Monday.
DESCRIPTION: Pt taken to OR, time-out done: name, DOB and procedure confirmed. Perioperative cefazolin 2000 mg IV, heparin SQ. Abdomen insufflated, 4 trocars. The sigmoid lesion was identified, tattoo visible from previous colonoscopy (04/14/2069 polyp site). Vessels liagted, mesentery taken, specimen extracted via Pfannenstiel. Stapled colorrectal anastomosis, leak test neg. EBL 150 mL. Fascia closed, skin staples. Counts correct x2.
SPECIMEN (label OCR'd from photo, may be wrong): "SZAB0-LINDAHL, MARGlT ACC# S70-22841 DOB 11/03/1998 BARCODE B 00 7746 0031 SIGMOID COLON, STITCH = PROXIMAL" To pathology, Dr. Padma Venkataraghavan. COMPLICATIONS: none. DISPOSITION: PACU, stable.
Copy-forward (from 7/27 pre-op H&P): "Pt denies chet pain. Last colonoscopy mid-April 2069. Allergies: NKDA. Social: married, lives w/ husband in Madison; daughter Ilse flew in from Gothenburg, Sweden." Dictated by A. de Wit-Pasternak MD 08/03/2070 14:40; electronically signed 08/04/2070 08:02
